name: Eyes of the Tiger
body:
You can strike fear in your opponents just by your mere presence.

Prerequisite(s): Ki pool class feature

Benefit: Because of your Ki Pool, you gain a +4 bonus on Intimidate checks and can demoralize all opponents within 60 feet as a move action and long as they can clearly see and hear you.

As long as there is at least 1 point in his ki pool, you can make use this feat.
